question: Let \(f:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R\) be given by \(f(x)=|x^2-1|,\ x\in\mathbb R.\) Then

options.A: \(f\) has a local minimum at \(x=\pm1\) but no local maximum
options.B: \(f\) has a local maximum at \(x=0\) but no local minima
options.C: \(f\) has a local minima at \(x=\pm1\) and a local maximum at \(x=0\)
options.D: none of the above is true.

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10 + 2 Level
